summary: The diff implements Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors in its own file, with each spec step as a comment directly above its code. Order matches the spec: ToObject, then [[OwnPropertyKeys]], then OrdinaryObjectCreate(%Object.prototype%), then per key [[GetOwnProperty]] (with ?), FromPropertyDescriptor, and CreateDataPropertyOrThrow only when the result is an object. Every abstract operation propagates errors with ?. There are no special-cased inputs, no fallback values, and no edits outside the in-scope file. The GC rooting around the loop looks reasonable: the coerced object, the keys and the result object are rooted. I could not verify the rooting helper APIs from the diff alone, so the build and the 28 newly passing test262 runs are the evidence for them.
